tagline: Synthesized kick, snare, clap and hi-hats on the GM drum map
description: A drum synth with five sounds made from oscillators and filtered noise: kick, snare, clap, closed hi-hat and open hi-hat. Notes follow the General MIDI drum map, each hit plays at its own position in the block and at its velocity, and a closed hat chokes an open one.

features.name: Kick
features.description: Sine with a pitch sweep from 3x down to the set pitch (30-100 Hz), plus decay, click, tone and drive

features.name: Snare
features.description: A tuned body mixed with band-passed noise (3.5-6.5 kHz), with tune, snap, tone, decay and mix

features.name: Clap
features.description: Several short bursts of band-passed noise followed by a tail, with tone and decay

features.name: Closed and open hi-hat
features.description: Filtered noise with tune, decay, tone and click; the open hat rings longer, and a closed or pedal hat cuts it off

features.name: GM note map
features.description: C1 kick, D1 snare, D#1 clap, F#1 and G#1 closed hat, A#1 open hat

features.name: Velocity and timing
features.description: Each hit's level follows its velocity, and hits start on their exact sample within the block

useCases: Electronic drum parts programmed on the GM drum map
Drum clips written for other GM instruments, played back unchanged
Layering a synthesized kick or clap under recorded drums
Learning how kicks, snares and hats are built from oscillators and noise
